title: Senate Armed Services staff on Admiral Wilson

tellings.quote: reverse engineered UFOs I talked to some staff members of the Senate arms committee
And he goes and I talked to the people that subpoenaed him.
tellings.difference: Frames it as Wilson being subpoenaed into a SCIF in the 2020s.
tellings.link_reason: In both, Fox talks to the Senate committee people who called Admiral Wilson in about reverse-engineered UFOs, and they relay his response.

as_told.title: Admiral Wilson's response to being called into a SCIF

plain: Staff on the Senate Armed Services Committee are said to have spoken about a Navy admiral named Thomas R. Wilson and reverse-engineered UFOs, meaning craft taken apart to learn how they work. A UFO investigator named James Fox tells Michels he talked to some of those staff members himself. Michels tells it differently: someone told him, "I talked to the people that subpoenaed him", and he frames it as Wilson being called into a secure room in the 2020s. The tellers raise it because it would mean Congress pressed a senior officer about hidden programmes.
